title: Aged Life
description: Custom season for the custom Life Series mod!
body:
Add-on for the fanmade Life Series mod

_Limited Life_, but you start as a baby and grow up overtime!

- ❤️ **<8** Hours: Red, Adult
- 💛 **<16** Hours: Yellow, Teen
- 💚 **<24** Hours: Green, Child

Each age group experiences their own challenges and hurdles. 
Instead of a boogeyman, the Secret Society is in play!
Babies can ride Teens and Adults by going next to one who's sneaking.

To use:
- Enable players riding players in your server's config
- Choose Limited Life on the Life Series mod
- Disable the Boogeyman and enable the Secret Society with /lifeseries config

Enjoy!
